content: {"paper_id":"W2104739568","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"We mainly present PSD for multi-class learning and further extend it to multi-label learning.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确将PSD扩展到多标记学习，说明方法用于预测多个可同时成立的标签。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"It is noteworthy that this task becomes challenging when there are only limited labeled training data points and no constraints are given explicitly. Moreover, most existing approaches aim to construct a global distance metric that is applicable to all data points. However, different data points may have different properties and may require different distance metrics. We notice that data points in real tasks are often connected by physical links (e.g., people are linked with each other in social networks; personal webpages are often connected to other webpages, including nonpersonal webpages), but the linkage information has not been exploited in distance metric learning.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要以有限标注训练点和未显式给出的约束为挑战，并利用物理链接结构辅助距离度量学习，符合有限监督加未标注结构的学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Experimental results validate the effectiveness of PSD, especially in the scenarios in which there are very limited labeled training data points and no explicit constraints are given.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要将非常有限的标注训练点和无显式约束作为重要实验场景，属于以不完整监督信号为实质研究条件的弱监督设定。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"pairwise-constraint-propagation","reason_zh":"摘要提到must-links/cannot-links约束作为一般背景，并强调没有显式约束；未见将成对约束扩展或传播并用于训练的机制。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","reason_zh":"摘要提到利用物理链接结构，但未说明使用图拉普拉斯、邻域或流形一致性正则来约束学习结果。"}],"input_issues":[]}
